<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>X HORIZON | Space Concepts</title>


<style>
/* =========================================================
   X HORIZON — TRUE FULL WIDTH ODOO RESET
   ========================================================= */

html,
body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 100% !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
  background: #020713 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif !important;
}

#wrapwrap,
#wrap,
main,
.o_website_root,
.oe_structure,
.oe_empty,
.o_editable,
.o_colored_level,
.s_text_block,
.s_embed_code,
.o_container_small,
.o_container_medium,
.o_container_large,
.container,
.container-fluid,
.row,
.col,
[class*="col-"] {
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}

/* Custom header/footer visibility preserved. No global header/footer hide rule here. */

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* =========================================================
   PAGE BASE — FULL BLEED 100VW
   ========================================================= */

#xhConceptsPage,
#xhConceptsPage * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#xhConceptsPage a {
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

#xhConceptsPage {
  --xh-bg: #020713;
  --xh-card: rgba(9, 19, 36, 0.88);
  --xh-border: rgba(142, 180, 255, 0.18);
  --xh-border-strong: rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.44);
  --xh-text: #ffffff;
  --xh-muted: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.72);
  --xh-soft: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.52);
  --xh-blue: #8eb9ff;
  --xh-blue-2: #c9ddff;

  position: relative !important;
  left: 50% !important;
  right: 50% !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin-left: -50vw !important;
  margin-right: -50vw !important;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 8%, rgba(75, 125, 210, 0.14), transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 0%, rgba(118, 159, 230, 0.09), transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #020713 0%, #050b18 45%, #020713 100%);
  color: var(--xh-text);
  isolation: isolate;
}

#xhConceptsPage::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.42) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(142,185,255,0.30) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px);
  background-size: 130px 130px, 215px 215px;
  background-position: 0 0, 50px 80px;
  opacity: 0.13;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -3;
}

#xhConceptsPage::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 0%, rgba(120, 170, 255, 0.03) 45%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -2;
}

.xh-page-shell {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* =========================================================
   HERO — FULL WIDTH MAIN SECTION
   ========================================================= */

.xh-hero {
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  min-height: 570px;
  display: grid;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.72), rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.28)),
    url("https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/iss070e023856/iss070e023856~orig.jpg") center center / cover no-repeat,
    #020713;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(142, 180, 255, 0.18);
  box-shadow:
    0 28px 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

.xh-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100%;
  z-index: 0;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center center;
  filter: saturate(0.96) contrast(1.08) brightness(0.72);
  transform: scale(1.01);
}

.xh-hero-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.98) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.84) 46%, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.40) 100%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 22% 38%, rgba(142,185,255,0.12), transparent 30%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.xh-hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(100%, 980px);
  padding: 132px clamp(18px, 5vw, 74px) 74px;
}

.xh-hero-tools {
  position: absolute;
  top: 28px;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 6;
  width: min(92vw, 540px);
  margin: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.xh-search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

.xh-concept-search {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 12px 54px 12px 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.18) !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #050d1a !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 650;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.28);
}

.xh-concept-search::placeholder {
  color: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.55);
}

.xh-concept-search:focus {
  border-color: rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.42) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(142, 185, 255, 0.10), 0 16px 38px rgba(0,0,0,0.32);
}

.xh-search-btn {
  position: absolute;
  right: 6px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border: 0 !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d2445, #1a4a82);
  color: #ffffff;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
}

.xh-admin-panel {
  display: none;
  width: min(100%, 780px);
  margin: 18px 0 24px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #050d1a;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(0,0,0,0.34);
}

#xhConceptsPage.xh-admin-open .xh-admin-panel {
  display: block;
}

.xh-admin-panel h3 {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.xh-admin-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}

.xh-admin-grid label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  color: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.xh-admin-grid input,
.xh-admin-grid textarea,
.xh-admin-grid select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.18) !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #020713 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.xh-admin-grid textarea {
  min-height: 90px;
  resize: vertical;
}

.xh-admin-wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.xh-admin-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.xh-admin-actions button {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border: 0 !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1a33 0%, #12315c 62%, #1a4578 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 850;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
}

.xh-admin-actions button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.xh-admin-actions .xh-danger-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #341018, #722234);
}

.xh-admin-actions .xh-lock-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #161d2b, #28364e);
}

.xh-admin-status {
  min-height: 20px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.xh-no-results {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #050d1a;
  color: rgba(226, 236, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}

#xhConceptsPage.xh-empty-search .xh-no-results {
  display: block;
}

.xh-kicker {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 8px 13px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.26);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(7, 18, 35, 0.72);
  color: var(--xh-blue-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.xh-kicker-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--xh-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(142,185,255,0.8);
}

.xh-hero h1 {
  margin: 22px 0 18px;
  max-width: 860px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(42px, 8vw, 96px);
  line-height: 0.92;
  letter-spacing: -0.065em;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.xh-hero h1 span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--xh-blue-2);
}

.xh-hero p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 720px;
  color: var(--xh-muted);
  font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.xh-hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}

.xh-main-btn,
.xh-soft-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 13px 20px;
  border: 0 !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  transition: transform 260ms ease, background 260ms ease, box-shadow 260ms ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.xh-main-btn {
  color: #06101f !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #c9ddff 45%, #7faeff 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(87, 132, 210, 0.28);
}

.xh-soft-btn {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #061225 0%, #0c2346 58%, #132f59 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
}

.xh-main-btn:hover,
.xh-soft-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(67, 112, 195, 0.22);
}

.xh-hero-meta {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 34px;
  max-width: 760px;
}

.xh-meta-box {
  min-height: 86px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(4, 12, 25, 0.58);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.xh-meta-box strong {
  display: block;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.xh-meta-box span {
  color: var(--xh-soft);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* =========================================================
   CONTENT AREA — FULL WIDTH
   ========================================================= */

.xh-content-area {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 70px clamp(14px, 2.4vw, 34px) 76px;
}

.xh-section-head {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0 0 26px;
}

.xh-section-head .xh-kicker {
  width: fit-content;
}

.xh-section-head h2 {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 900px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 5vw, 58px);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  font-weight: 840;
}

.xh-section-head p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 780px;
  color: var(--xh-muted);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

/* =========================================================
   CARDS — MOBILE FIRST
   ========================================================= */

.xh-category-grid {
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
}

.xh-category-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--xh-border);
  border-radius: 28px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 25, 45, 0.9), rgba(5, 12, 25, 0.97));
  box-shadow:
    0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition:
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    border-color 320ms ease,
    box-shadow 320ms ease;
}

.xh-category-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.018) rotateX(1.2deg);
  border-color: rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.30);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d1a30 0%, #050d1a 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 58px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48);
}

.xh-category-card::before,
.xh-category-card:hover::before {
  content: none !important;
  display: none !important;
}


.xh-img-box {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 190px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #07111f;
}

.xh-img-box img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.94) contrast(1.08) brightness(0.9);
  transform: scale(1.02);
  transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 320ms ease;
}

.xh-category-card:hover .xh-img-box img {
  transform: scale(1.08);
  filter: saturate(1.02) contrast(1.1) brightness(0.98);
}

.xh-img-box::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.32) 50%, rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.92) 100%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(142,185,255,0.1), transparent 55%);
}

.xh-number {
  position: absolute;
  left: 16px;
  top: 16px;
  z-index: 3;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 44px;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
  background: rgba(3, 9, 20, 0.74);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.xh-card-body {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 22px;
}

.xh-card-body h3 {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.16;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  font-weight: 820;
}

.xh-card-body p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--xh-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.xh-card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.xh-card-tags span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035);
  color: rgba(232, 240, 255, 0.74);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.xh-card-action {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  min-height: 42px;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 11px 15px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 0 !important;
  outline: 0 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1a33 0%, #12315c 62%, #1a4578 100%);
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 820;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.24);
  transition: transform 260ms ease, background 260ms ease, box-shadow 260ms ease;
}

.xh-card-action span {
  transition: transform 260ms ease;
}

.xh-card-action:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #102443 0%, #1a4273 62%, #245d9d 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(67, 112, 195, 0.2);
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.xh-card-action:hover span {
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.xh-bottom-panel {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 34px;
  padding: 26px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 205, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 30px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%, rgba(142,185,255,0.12), transparent 32%),
    rgba(6, 15, 31, 0.78);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}

.xh-bottom-panel h3 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: clamp(23px, 4vw, 34px);
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.xh-bottom-panel p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 900px;
  color: var(--xh-muted);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

/* =========================================================
   SCROLL REVEAL — ONE BY ONE
   ========================================================= */

#xhConceptsPage.xh-ready .xh-reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(34px) scale(0.985);
  filter: blur(7px);
}

#xhConceptsPage.xh-ready .xh-reveal.xh-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  filter: blur(0);
  transition:
    opacity 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    transform 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    filter 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* =========================================================
   TABLET VERSION
   ========================================================= */

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .xh-category-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .xh-img-box {
    height: 205px;
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DESKTOP VERSION
   ========================================================= */

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .xh-category-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .xh-img-box {
    height: 215px;
  }

  .xh-category-card:nth-child(1),
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(4),
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(9),
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(14) {
    min-height: 468px;
  }

  .xh-category-card:nth-child(1) .xh-img-box,
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(4) .xh-img-box,
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(9) .xh-img-box,
  .xh-category-card:nth-child(14) .xh-img-box {
    height: 250px;
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   LARGE DESKTOP VERSION — STILL 100% WIDTH
   ========================================================= */

@media (min-width: 1440px) {
  .xh-category-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .xh-hero-content {
    width: min(100%, 1100px);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   MOBILE VERSION
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 639px) {
  #xhConceptsPage {
    width: 100vw !important;
    max-width: 100vw !important;
  }

  .xh-hero {
    width: 100vw !important;
    min-height: 100svh;
  }

  .xh-hero-bg {
    object-position: center center;
  }

  .xh-hero-overlay {
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.92) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.84) 58%, rgba(2, 7, 19, 0.72) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(142,185,255,0.12), transparent 36%);
  }

  .xh-hero-content {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 108px 16px 34px;
  }

  .xh-hero-tools {
    position: absolute;
    top: 18px;
    left: 50%;
    width: min(92vw, 540px);
    margin: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }

  .xh-admin-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .xh-kicker {
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.11em;
    padding: 7px 11px;
  }

  .xh-hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(42px, 15vw, 64px);
    letter-spacing: -0.055em;
  }

  .xh-hero p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.68;
  }

  .xh-hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 11px;
    margin-top: 26px;
  }

  .xh-main-btn,
  .xh-soft-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 48px;
  }

  .xh-hero-meta {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 28px;
  }

  .xh-meta-box {
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .xh-content-area {
    padding: 44px 10px 54px;
  }

  .xh-section-head {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .xh-section-head h2 {
    font-size: clamp(30px, 10vw, 42px);
  }

  .xh-section-head p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.68;
  }

  .xh-category-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .xh-category-card {
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .xh-img-box {
    height: 178px;
  }

  .xh-card-body {
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .xh-card-body h3 {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .xh-card-body p {
    font-size: 13.5px;
  }

  .xh-card-action {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .xh-bottom-panel {
    border-radius: 22px;
    padding: 20px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  #xhConceptsPage.xh-ready .xh-reveal,
  #xhConceptsPage.xh-ready .xh-reveal.xh-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
    transition: none;
  }

  .xh-category-card,
  .xh-img-box img,
  .xh-main-btn,
  .xh-soft-btn,
  .xh-card-action,
  .xh-card-action span {
    transition: none;
  }
}

:root{--xh-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}

body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif!important}

.xh-loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#000;transition:opacity .65s var(--xh-ease),visibility .65s var(--xh-ease);pointer-events:auto}

.xh-load-x{position:absolute;left:42px;top:6px;z-index:2;color:#fff;font-size:96px;line-height:1;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.12em;text-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.xh-load-word{position:absolute;left:112px;top:45px;z-index:3;color:#eee;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.20em;opacity:.18;line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;will-change:opacity}
.xh-loader.loading .xh-load-word{animation:xhLoaderWordBlink .42s steps(2,end) infinite}

<div class="xh-loader loading" id="xhLoader" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="xh-load-mark">
    <div class="xh-load-x">X</div>
    <div class="xh-load-word" id="xhLoadWord">HORIZON</div>
    <div class="xh-load-line"><span class="xh-load-fill" id="xhLoadFill"></span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var loader = document.getElementById("xhLoader");
  var fill = document.getElementById("xhLoadFill");
  if (!loader || !fill) return;
  var start = Date.now();
  var duration = 1750;
  var completed = false;
  function finish(){
    if (completed) return;
    completed = true;
    fill.style.width = "100%";
    loader.className = loader.className.replace(/\bloading\b/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() + " ready";
    window.setTimeout(function(){ loader.className += " done"; }, 420);
  }
  function frame(){
    var elapsed = Date.now() - start;
    var progress = Math.min(100, Math.round((elapsed / duration) * 100));
    fill.style.width = progress + "%";
    if (progress >= 100) { finish(); return; }
    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "complete") {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(frame); });
  }
  window.setTimeout(finish, 3200);
})();
</script>

<script type="module">
/* X HORIZON Firebase admin bridge: uses existing root bridge if present, otherwise initializes from safe global config. */
import { initializeApp, getApps } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-app.js";
import { getAuth, signInWithCustomToken } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-auth.js";
import { getFunctions, httpsCallable } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/firebase-functions.js";

(function(){
  const cfg = window.XHORIZON_FIREBASE_CONFIG || window.XHorizonFirebaseConfig || null;
  const fnName = window.XHORIZON_ADMIN_VERIFY_FUNCTION || "verifyAdminKey";
  function configured(c){
    return !!(c && c.apiKey && c.projectId && !String(c.apiKey).includes("YOUR_") && !String(c.projectId).includes("YOUR_"));
  }
  if (window.XHorizonAdmin && typeof window.XHorizonAdmin.unlock === "function") {
    window.XHorizonFirebaseReady = true;
    return;
  }
  if (!configured(cfg)) {
    window.XHorizonFirebaseReady = false;
    window.XHorizonAdmin = window.XHorizonAdmin || {
      unlock: async function(){
        console.error("X Horizon Firebase config missing. Define window.XHORIZON_FIREBASE_CONFIG in root/Odoo General JS.");
        return false;
      }
    };
    return;
  }
  let app = null, auth = null, functions = null;
  try {
    app = getApps().length ? getApps()[0] : initializeApp(cfg);
    auth = getAuth(app);
    functions = getFunctions(app);
    window.XHorizonFirebaseReady = true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("X Horizon Firebase initialization failed:", error);
    window.XHorizonFirebaseReady = false;
    return;
  }
  window.XHorizonAdmin = {
    async unlock(key, done){
      const cleanKey = String(key || "").trim();
      if (!cleanKey || !auth || !functions) return false;
      try {
        const verifyAdminKey = httpsCallable(functions, fnName);
        const result = await verifyAdminKey({ key: cleanKey });
        const data = result && result.data ? result.data : {};
        const allowed = data.allowed === true || data.admin === true || data.success === true;
        const customToken = data.token || data.customToken || data.firebaseToken || "";
        if (customToken) await signInWithCustomToken(auth, customToken);
        let claimAllowed = false;
        if (auth.currentUser) {
          const tokenResult = await auth.currentUser.getIdTokenResult(true);
          claimAllowed = tokenResult.claims && (tokenResult.claims.admin === true || tokenResult.claims.xhAdmin === true || tokenResult.claims.role === "admin");
        }
        const ok = allowed || claimAllowed;
        if (ok && typeof done === "function") done();
        return ok;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("X Horizon admin verification failed:", error);
        return false;
      }
    }
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState !== "loading") {
      fn();
    } else {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    }
  }

  function hasClass(el, className) {
    return el && (" " + el.className + " ").indexOf(" " + className + " ") > -1;
  }

  function addClass(el, className) {
    if (el && !hasClass(el, className)) {
      el.className = (el.className ? el.className + " " : "") + className;
    }
  }

  function makePlaceholder(title) {
    var safeTitle = String(title || "X HORIZON")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");

    var svg =
      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="760" viewBox="0 0 1200 760">' +
      '<defs>' +
      '<radialGradient id="g1" cx="28%" cy="18%" r="76%">' +
      '<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1b3d73"/>' +
      '<stop offset="55%" stop-color="#071326"/>' +
      '<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#020713"/>' +
      '</radialGradient>' +
      '</defs>' +
      '<rect width="1200" height="760" fill="url(#g1)"/>' +
      '<circle cx="870" cy="250" r="175" fill="#8eb9ff" opacity=".16"/>' +
      '<path d="M190 520 C 390 380, 700 360, 1010 210" fill="none" stroke="#8eb9ff" stroke-width="2" opacity=".22"/>' +
      '<text x="60" y="660" fill="#ffffff" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="800">' + safeTitle + '</text>' +
      '<text x="64" y="705" fill="#c9ddff" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="4">X HORIZON</text>' +
      '</svg>';

    return "data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8," + encodeURIComponent(svg);
  }

  ready(function () {
    var page = document.getElementById("xhConceptsPage");
    if (!page) return;

    addClass(page, "xh-ready");

    var allImages = Array.prototype.slice.call(page.querySelectorAll("img"));
    allImages.forEach(function (img) {
      var fallback = makePlaceholder(img.alt || "X HORIZON");
      img.onerror = function () {
        img.onerror = null;
        img.src = fallback;
      };
    });

    var storageKey = "xhConceptsCardsLocalV1";
    var grid = document.getElementById("xhConceptGrid");
    var searchForm = document.getElementById("xhConceptSearchForm");
    var searchInput = document.getElementById("xhConceptSearch");
    var searchButton = page.querySelector(".xh-search-btn");
    var adminPanel = document.getElementById("xhAdminPanel");
    var adminSelect = document.getElementById("xhAdminSelect");
    var adminTitle = document.getElementById("xhAdminTitle");
    var adminLink = document.getElementById("xhAdminLink");
    var adminImage = document.getElementById("xhAdminImage");
    var adminDescription = document.getElementById("xhAdminDescription");
    var adminTags = document.getElementById("xhAdminTags");
    var adminSave = document.getElementById("xhAdminSave");
    var adminAdd = document.getElementById("xhAdminAdd");
    var adminDelete = document.getElementById("xhAdminDelete");
    var adminReset = document.getElementById("xhAdminReset");
    var adminLock = document.getElementById("xhAdminLock");

    function normalizeText(value) {
      return String(value || "").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    }

    function safeUrl(value) {
      var url = String(value || "").trim();
      if (!url) return "#";
      if (/^\s*javascript:/i.test(url)) return "#";
      return url;
    }

    /* Admin key removed: unlock is handled by window.XHorizonAdmin in Odoo General JS / Firebase. */
    function setAdminStatus(message) {
      var status = document.getElementById("xhAdminStatus");
      if (status) status.textContent = message || "";
    }

    function getCards() {
      if (!grid) return [];
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll(".xh-category-card"));
    }

    function getCardData(card, index) {
      var titleEl = card.querySelector("h3");
      var descEl = card.querySelector("p");
      var imageEl = card.querySelector(".xh-img-box img");
      var linkEl = card.querySelector(".xh-card-action");
      var tagEls = Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll(".xh-card-tags span"));
      return {
        number: String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
        title: titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : "",
        description: descEl ? descEl.textContent.trim() : "",
        image: imageEl ? imageEl.getAttribute("src") : "",
        alt: imageEl ? imageEl.getAttribute("alt") : "",
        link: linkEl ? linkEl.getAttribute("href") : "#",
        tags: tagEls.map(function (tag) { return tag.textContent.trim(); }).filter(Boolean)
      };
    }

    function renumberCards() {
      getCards().forEach(function (card, index) {
        var number = card.querySelector(".xh-number");
        if (number) number.textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      });
    }

    function saveLocalCards() {
      try {
        var data = getCards().map(getCardData);
        window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(data));
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function makeCard(data, index) {
      var article = document.createElement("article");
      article.className = "xh-category-card xh-reveal xh-visible";
      article.setAttribute("data-xh-shown", "1");

      var imgBox = document.createElement("div");
      imgBox.className = "xh-img-box";

      var img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = data.image || makePlaceholder(data.title || "X HORIZON");
      img.alt = data.alt || data.title || "X HORIZON";
      img.loading = "lazy";
      img.onerror = function () {
        img.onerror = null;
        img.src = makePlaceholder(data.title || "X HORIZON");
      };

      var number = document.createElement("span");
      number.className = "xh-number";
      number.textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");

      imgBox.appendChild(img);
      imgBox.appendChild(number);

      var body = document.createElement("div");
      body.className = "xh-card-body";

      var title = document.createElement("h3");
      title.textContent = data.title || "New Space Concept";

      var desc = document.createElement("p");
      desc.textContent = data.description || "Add a short description for this concept category.";

      var tags = document.createElement("div");
      tags.className = "xh-card-tags";
      (data.tags && data.tags.length ? data.tags : ["Concept"]).slice(0, 5).forEach(function (tagText) {
        var tag = document.createElement("span");
        tag.textContent = tagText;
        tags.appendChild(tag);
      });

      var action = document.createElement("a");
      action.className = "xh-card-action";
      action.href = safeUrl(data.link);
      action.innerHTML = "Explore Category <span>→</span>";

      body.appendChild(title);
      body.appendChild(desc);
      body.appendChild(tags);
      body.appendChild(action);
      article.appendChild(imgBox);
      article.appendChild(body);
      return article;
    }

    function loadLocalCards() {
      if (!grid) return;
      try {
        var raw = window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        if (!raw) return;
        var data = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) return;
        grid.innerHTML = "";
        data.forEach(function (cardData, index) {
          grid.appendChild(makeCard(cardData, index));
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function fillAdminSelect() {
      if (!adminSelect) return;
      var cards = getCards();
      adminSelect.innerHTML = "";
      cards.forEach(function (card, index) {
        var data = getCardData(card, index);
        var option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = String(index);
        option.textContent = data.number + " — " + data.title;
        adminSelect.appendChild(option);
      });
      loadAdminFields();
    }

    function loadAdminFields() {
      if (!adminSelect) return;
      var index = parseInt(adminSelect.value || "0", 10);
      var card = getCards()[index];
      if (!card) return;
      var data = getCardData(card, index);
      if (adminTitle) adminTitle.value = data.title;
      if (adminLink) adminLink.value = data.link;
      if (adminImage) adminImage.value = data.image;
      if (adminDescription) adminDescription.value = data.description;
      if (adminTags) adminTags.value = data.tags.join(", ");
    }

    function readAdminFields() {
      return {
        title: adminTitle ? adminTitle.value.trim() : "",
        description: adminDescription ? adminDescription.value.trim() : "",
        image: adminImage ? adminImage.value.trim() : "",
        alt: adminTitle ? adminTitle.value.trim() : "",
        link: adminLink ? safeUrl(adminLink.value) : "#",
        tags: adminTags ? adminTags.value.split(",").map(function (tag) { return tag.trim(); }).filter(Boolean) : []
      };
    }

    function applyDataToCard(card, data) {
      if (!card) return;
      var titleEl = card.querySelector("h3");
      var descEl = card.querySelector("p");
      var imageEl = card.querySelector(".xh-img-box img");
      var linkEl = card.querySelector(".xh-card-action");
      var tagsEl = card.querySelector(".xh-card-tags");

      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = data.title || "New Space Concept";
      if (descEl) descEl.textContent = data.description || "Add a short description for this concept category.";
      if (imageEl) {
        imageEl.src = data.image || makePlaceholder(data.title || "X HORIZON");
        imageEl.alt = data.title || "X HORIZON";
      }
      if (linkEl) linkEl.href = safeUrl(data.link);
      if (tagsEl) {
        tagsEl.innerHTML = "";
        (data.tags.length ? data.tags : ["Concept"]).slice(0, 5).forEach(function (tagText) {
          var tag = document.createElement("span");
          tag.textContent = tagText;
          tagsEl.appendChild(tag);
        });
      }
    }

    function openAdminMode() {
      addClass(page, "xh-admin-open");
      if (adminPanel) adminPanel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      fillAdminSelect();
      if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.value = "";
        searchInput.placeholder = "Admin unlocked — search concepts or edit below";
      }
      setAdminStatus("Admin mode unlocked.");
      filterCards("");
    }

    function closeAdminMode() {
      page.className = page.className.replace(/\bxh-admin-open\b/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (adminPanel) adminPanel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.value = "";
        searchInput.placeholder = "Search concepts...";
      }
      setAdminStatus("");
      filterCards("");
    }

    function filterCards(query) {
      var normalized = normalizeText(query);
      var cards = getCards();
      var visibleCount = 0;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var data = getCardData(card, 0);
        var haystack = normalizeText(data.title + " " + data.description + " " + data.tags.join(" "));
        var match = !normalized || haystack.indexOf(normalized) > -1;
        card.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
        if (match) visibleCount += 1;
      });

      if (normalized && visibleCount === 0) {
        addClass(page, "xh-empty-search");
      } else {
        page.className = page.className.replace(/\bxh-empty-search\b/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      }
    }

    loadLocalCards();
    renumberCards();

    function setSearchButtonState(isChecking) {
      if (!searchButton) return;
      searchButton.disabled = !!isChecking;
      searchButton.textContent = isChecking ? "Checking" : "Search";
    }

    function handleSearchSubmit() {
      var value = searchInput ? searchInput.value.trim() : "";
      if (!value) {
        filterCards("");
        return;
      }

      if (window.XHorizonAdmin && typeof window.XHorizonAdmin.unlock === "function") {
        setSearchButtonState(true);
        searchInput.placeholder = "Checking admin authorization...";
        setAdminStatus("Checking Firebase admin authorization...");

        var unlockedByCallback = false;
        Promise.resolve(window.XHorizonAdmin.unlock(value, function () {
          unlockedByCallback = true;
          openAdminMode();
        })).then(function (ok) {
          if (ok && !unlockedByCallback) {
            openAdminMode();
            return;
          }
          if (!ok) {
            setAdminStatus("No admin match. Showing search results.");
            searchInput.placeholder = "Search concepts...";
            filterCards(value);
          }
        }).catch(function (error) {
          console.error("X Horizon admin unlock failed:", error);
          setAdminStatus("Firebase admin authorization failed. Showing search results.");
          searchInput.placeholder = "Search concepts...";
          filterCards(value);
        }).finally(function () {
          setSearchButtonState(false);
        });
        return;
      }

      setAdminStatus("Firebase admin bridge not found. Showing search results.");
      filterCards(value);
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
        filterCards(searchInput.value);
      });
    }

    if (searchForm) {
      searchForm.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        handleSearchSubmit();
      });
    }

    if (adminSelect) {
      adminSelect.addEventListener("change", loadAdminFields);
    }

    if (adminSave) {
      adminSave.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var index = parseInt(adminSelect && adminSelect.value ? adminSelect.value : "0", 10);
        var card = getCards()[index];
        applyDataToCard(card, readAdminFields());
        renumberCards();
        saveLocalCards();
        fillAdminSelect();
        if (adminSelect) adminSelect.value = String(index);
      });
    }

    if (adminAdd) {
      adminAdd.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!grid) return;
        var data = readAdminFields();
        grid.appendChild(makeCard(data, getCards().length));
        renumberCards();
        saveLocalCards();
        fillAdminSelect();
        if (adminSelect) adminSelect.value = String(getCards().length - 1);
        loadAdminFields();
      });
    }

    if (adminDelete) {
      adminDelete.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var index = parseInt(adminSelect && adminSelect.value ? adminSelect.value : "0", 10);
        var card = getCards()[index];
        if (card && card.parentNode) {
          card.parentNode.removeChild(card);
          renumberCards();
          saveLocalCards();
          fillAdminSelect();
          filterCards(searchInput ? searchInput.value : "");
        }
      });
    }

    if (adminReset) {
      adminReset.addEventListener("click", function () {
        try {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        } catch (e) {}
        window.location.reload();
      });
    }

    if (adminLock) {
      adminLock.addEventListener("click", closeAdminMode);
    }

    var reduceMotion = false;
    try {
      reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    } catch (e) {}

    var revealItems = Array.prototype.slice.call(page.querySelectorAll(".xh-reveal"));

    function revealOne(el) {
      if (!el || el.getAttribute("data-xh-shown") === "1") return;
      el.setAttribute("data-xh-shown", "1");
      addClass(el, "xh-visible");
    }

    if (reduceMotion) {
      revealItems.forEach(revealOne);
      return;
    }

    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        var visible = entries
          .filter(function (entry) {
            return entry.isIntersecting;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return revealItems.indexOf(a.target) - revealItems.indexOf(b.target);
          });

        visible.forEach(function (entry, index) {
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            revealOne(entry.target);
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }, index * 145);
        });
      }, {
        threshold: 0.18,
        rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px"
      });

      revealItems.forEach(function (el) {
        observer.observe(el);
      });
    } else {
      revealItems.forEach(function (el, index) {
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          revealOne(el);
        }, index * 130);
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   LEARNING PROGRESS + CERTIFICATES — ODOO IDENTITY + FIRESTORE
   Uses the Odoo session identity exposed to the page; no Google sign-in, Worker, or custom name.
   Certificate JPGs are generated in-browser and downloaded directly. Firestore rules must permit
   the intended operations before remote records can be saved or read.
   ========================================================= */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ========== CONFIG — the only values you edit in this block ========== */
  var XH_CERT = {
    /* Public Firebase web config (safe to be public). Do NOT put it in window.XHORIZON_FIREBASE_CONFIG:
       the admin bridge above reads that global and must keep pointing at its own project. */
    firebase: {
      apiKey: "AIzaSyDPtP3bu1o5VZS1-FXuha42u_J4wBhzrlw",
      authDomain: "x-horizon-certifications.firebaseapp.com",
      projectId: "x-horizon-certifications",
      storageBucket: "x-horizon-certifications.firebasestorage.app",
      messagingSenderId: "296218678023",
      appId: "1:296218678023:web:411407862eff06008faba2"
    },
    /* Dedicated Firebase app name; no Google sign-in and no external API/Worker. */
    appName: "xhCertifications"
  };

  var KEY = "xhLearnProgressV1",
      CK = "xhLearnCertV2",          /* local cache of Firebase certificate records */
      DWELL = 6000,
      FB = null, FBS = null, USER = null, ME_LOADED = false,
      SYNCED = {}, BUSY = {}, INFLIGHT = {}, FAILED = {};

  var SLUGS = [
    "universe-cosmology",
    "galaxy-large-scale-structure",
    "black-holes-related-phenomena",
    "solar-system-planetary-science",
    "space-technology-exploration",
    "exoplanets-astrobiology",
    "nebula-interstellar-objects",
    "stars-stellar-evolution",
    "quantum-physics-particle-concepts",
    "gravity-relativity",
    "high-energy-phenomena-transient-events",
    "sun-solar-phenomena",
    "human-spaceflight-life-support-system",
    "astrodynamics-life-support-system",
    "software-tools-in-space-science",
    "astronomy-observational-terms",
    "miscellaneous-terms"
  ];

  /* Category counts used by the certificate UI. Verify these against the live page data before final issuance. */
  var TOPIC_COUNTS = {
    "universe-cosmology": 17,
    "galaxy-large-scale-structure": 25,
    "black-holes-related-phenomena": 21,
    "solar-system-planetary-science": 62,
    "space-technology-exploration": 58,
    "exoplanets-astrobiology": 51,
    "nebula-interstellar-objects": 25,
    "stars-stellar-evolution": 46,
    "quantum-physics-particle-concepts": 35,
    "gravity-relativity": 40,
    "high-energy-phenomena-transient-events": 25,
    "sun-solar-phenomena": 35,
    "human-spaceflight-life-support-system": 38,
    "astrodynamics-life-support-system": 37,
    "software-tools-in-space-science": 39,
    "astronomy-observational-terms": 45,
    "miscellaneous-terms": 45
  };
  /* The old hard-coded 572 never matched the table (it summed to 597; with the two corrections above it is 644).
     The total is now derived from the table so the two can never disagree. */
  var MAIN_COUNT = SLUGS.reduce(function (n, s) { return n + (TOPIC_COUNTS[s] || 0); }, 0);

  function ld(k) { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } }
  function st(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
  /* Migrate saved progress keys when category URLs change; preserve existing read records. */
  (function migrateCategoryProgress() {
    try {
      var key = "xhLearnProgressV1";
      var data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "{}") || {};
      var moves = [
        ["black-holes-related-concepts", "black-holes-related-phenomena"],
        ["black-hole-related-phenomena", "black-holes-related-phenomena"],
        ["star-stellar-formation", "stars-stellar-evolution"]
      ];
      moves.forEach(function (pair) {
        var oldSlug = pair[0], newSlug = pair[1], oldEntry = data[oldSlug];
        if (!oldEntry) return;
        var current = data[newSlug];
        if (!current) {
          data[newSlug] = oldEntry;
        } else {
          current = data[newSlug] = {
            r: (Array.isArray(current.r) ? current.r : []).concat(
              (Array.isArray(oldEntry.r) ? oldEntry.r : []).filter(function (id) {
                return (Array.isArray(current.r) ? current.r : []).indexOf(id) < 0;
              })
            ),
            n: Math.max(Number(current.n) || 0, Number(oldEntry.n) || 0)
          };
        }
        delete data[oldSlug];
      });
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
  function put(d) { st(KEY, d); document.dispatchEvent(new Event("xhprogress")); }
  function slugOf(h) { return String(h || "").split(/[?#]/)[0].replace(/\/+$/, "").split("/").pop(); }
  function done(e) { return e && e.n > 0 ? Math.min(e.r.length, e.n) : 0; }
  function pct(e) { return e && e.n > 0 ? Math.round(done(e) / e.n * 100) : 0; }
  function esc(s) { return String(s || "").replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;"); }
  function fmtDate(iso) {
    var d = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(d) ? "" : d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
  }
  function configured() { return !!(XH_CERT.firebase && XH_CERT.firebase.projectId); }

  window.XHProgress = window.XHProgress || {
    get: function (s) { return ld(KEY)[s] || { r: [], n: 0 }; },
    read: function (s, id, total) {
      var d = ld(KEY), e = d[s] = d[s] || { r: [], n: 0 };
      if (total) e.n = total;
      if (id && e.r.indexOf(id) < 0) e.r.push(id);
      put(d);
    },
    set: function (s, read, total) {
      var d = ld(KEY), r = [], i;
      for (i = 0; i < read; i++) r.push("#" + i);
      d[s] = { r: r, n: total };
      put(d);
    },
    reset: function () { put({}); }
  };

  function bar(label, right, p) {
    return '<div class="xhp-top"><span>' + label + '</span><b>' + right + '</b></div><div class="xhp-line"><i style="width:' + p + '%"></i></div>';
  }

  /* ---------- Firebase + Odoo identity connector (no Google sign-in, no Worker) ---------- */
  async function odooSession() {
    var candidates = [];
    try { if (window.odoo && window.odoo.__session_info__) candidates.push(window.odoo.__session_info__); } catch (e) {}
    try { if (window.odoo && window.odoo.session_info) candidates.push(window.odoo.session_info); } catch (e) {}
    try { if (window.__session_info__) candidates.push(window.__session_info__); } catch (e) {}
    try { if (window.odoo && window.odoo.session) candidates.push(window.odoo.session); } catch (e) {}
    for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
      var x = candidates[i];
      var id = x.user_id || x.uid || (x.user && (x.user.user_id || x.user.id));
      var name = x.name || x.user_name || (x.user && (x.user.name || x.user.display_name));
      var email = x.username || x.email || (x.user && x.user.email) || "";
      if (id && name && Number(id) > 0) return { uid: String(id), name: String(name).trim(), email: String(email) };
    }
    /* On Odoo pages, ask the current same-origin Odoo session endpoint for the authenticated
       session identity. This uses the existing Odoo login; it does not create a second login. */
    try {
      var response = await fetch("/web/session/get_session_info", {
        method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", method: "call", params: {}, id: Date.now() })
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        var payload = await response.json(), info = payload && (payload.result || payload);
        var uid = info && (info.uid || info.user_id);
        var nm = info && (info.name || info.username);
        if (uid && Number(uid) > 0 && nm) return { uid: String(uid), name: String(nm).trim(), email: String(info.username || info.email || "") };
      }
    } catch (e) { console.warn("XH certificates: unable to read Odoo session:", e); }
    return null;
  }

  function configured() { return !!(XH_CERT.firebase && XH_CERT.firebase.projectId); }
  function fb() {
    if (FB) return FB;
    FB = (async function () {
      try {
        var V = "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.5/";
        var a = await import(V + "firebase-app.js");
        var fs = await import(V + "firebase-firestore.js");
        var cfg = XH_CERT.firebase, app = null, apps = a.getApps(), i;
        for (i = 0; i < apps.length; i++) { if (apps[i].name === XH_CERT.appName) { app = apps[i]; break; } }
        if (!app) app = a.initializeApp(cfg, XH_CERT.appName);
        FBS = { fs: fs, db: fs.getFirestore(app) };
        USER = await odooSession();
        if (!USER) console.info("XH certificates: no Odoo session identity was exposed to this page.");
        return FBS;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("XH cert: Firebase connection failed:", e);
        FB = null;
        return null;
      }
    })();
    return FB;
  }

  async function onUser() {
    USER = await odooSession();
    SYNCED = {}; INFLIGHT = {}; FAILED = {}; ME_LOADED = false;
    if (!USER) { render(); renderAuth(); return; }
    renderAuth();
    refreshMe();
  }

  async function api(method, path, body) {
    var sdk = await fb();
    if (!sdk || !FBS) throw new Error("firebase_unavailable");
    USER = await odooSession();
    if (!USER) throw new Error("odoo_login_required");
    var fs = FBS.fs, db = FBS.db, certs = fs.collection(db, "certificates"), completions = fs.collection(db, "completedCategories");
    if (method === "GET" && path === "/v1/me") {
      var cq = await fs.getDocs(fs.query(certs, fs.where("learnerId", "==", USER.uid)));
      var dq = await fs.getDocs(fs.query(completions, fs.where("learnerId", "==", USER.uid)));
      return { ok: true,
        certificates: cq.docs.map(function (d) { var v = d.data(); return Object.assign({ id: d.id }, v); }),
        completions: dq.docs.map(function (d) { return d.data(); }) };
    }
    if (method === "POST" && path === "/v1/complete") {
      var slug = body.slug;
      var rec = { learnerId: USER.uid, learnerName: USER.name, slug: slug, readIds: body.readIds || [], current: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await fs.setDoc(fs.doc(completions, USER.uid + "_" + slug), rec, { merge: true });
      return { ok: true };
    }
    if (method === "POST" && path === "/v1/certificate") {
      var slug = body.slug, main = slug === "main", d = ld(KEY);
      if (main && !SLUGS.every(function (x) { return pct(d[x]) >= 100; })) throw new Error("not_eligible");
      if (!main && (SLUGS.indexOf(slug) < 0 || !d[slug] || pct(d[slug]) < 100)) throw new Error("not_eligible");
      var prior = await fs.getDocs(fs.query(certs, fs.where("learnerId", "==", USER.uid), fs.where("slug", "==", slug)));
      var existing = prior.docs.find(function (x) { return x.data().status === "active"; });
      if (existing) return { ok: true, certificate: Object.assign({ id: existing.id }, existing.data()) };
      var cat = main ? "Space Science Mastery" : slug.replace(/-/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); });
      var count = main ? MAIN_COUNT : (TOPIC_COUNTS[slug] || 0);
      var prefix = main ? "UNIV" : slug.split("-").map(function (x) { return x.charAt(0); }).join("").toUpperCase().slice(0, 4);
      var random = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10).toUpperCase().padEnd(8, "X");
      var id = "XH-2026-" + prefix + "-" + random;
      var code = "VCD-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10).toUpperCase().padEnd(8, "X");
      var certificate = { learnerId: USER.uid, learnerName: USER.name, name: USER.name, slug: slug, cat: cat, count: count, main: main, status: "active", issuedAt: new Date().toISOString(), verificationCode: code, completedArticleCount: count };
      await fs.setDoc(fs.doc(certs, id), certificate);
      return { ok: true, certificate: Object.assign({ id: id }, certificate) };
    }
    throw new Error("unsupported_certificate_operation");
  }
  function errMsg(e) {
    var c = e && e.message;
    if (c === "not_eligible") return "Finish every article in this category before claiming its certificate.";
    if (c === "odoo_login_required") return "Please log in to X HORIZON through Odoo, then reload this page.";
    if (c && (c.indexOf("permission-denied") >= 0 || c.indexOf("Missing or insufficient permissions") >= 0)) return "Firebase is connected, but Firestore rules currently deny access. We must configure the rules before records can be saved or loaded.";
    return "Could not access Firebase. Check the Firebase connection and Firestore rules, then try again.";
  }
  function toRec(c) {
    return { id: c.id, name: c.name || c.learnerName || "Learner", slug: c.slug, cat: c.cat, count: c.count, main: !!c.main, date: fmtDate(c.issuedAt), issuedAt: c.issuedAt, verificationCode: c.verificationCode || "", status: c.status || "active", completedArticleCount: c.completedArticleCount || c.count };
  }

  async function refreshMe() {
    if (!configured() || !USER) return;
    try {
      var r = await api("GET", "/v1/me"), C = {};
      (r.certificates || []).forEach(function (c) { if (c.status === "active") C[c.slug] = toRec(c); });
      (r.completions || []).forEach(function (c) { if (c.current !== false) SYNCED[c.slug] = true; });
      st(CK, C);
      ME_LOADED = true;
    } catch (e) { console.warn("XH cert: could not load your records:", e && e.message); }
    render(); renderAuth();
  }

  /* ---------- Odoo account identity (no separate sign-in form) ---------- */
  function signIn() {
    alert("Please log in using the normal X HORIZON / Odoo login, then reload this page.");
    return Promise.resolve(null);
  }
  function signOut() {
    alert("To sign out, use the normal Odoo account menu.");
  }

  function renderAuth() {
    var box = document.getElementById("xhcAuth"), nf = document.getElementById("xhcName");
    if (nf) {
      nf.readOnly = true;
      nf.value = USER ? USER.name : "";
      nf.placeholder = "Use your logged-in Odoo account";
      var lab = nf.closest("label");
      if (lab) lab.style.display = "none";
    }
    if (!box) return;
    if (USER) {
      box.innerHTML = "<span>Odoo account: <b>" + esc(USER.name) + "</b>" + (USER.email ? " · " + esc(USER.email) : "") + "</span>";
    } else {
      box.innerHTML = "<span>Please log in to X HORIZON through Odoo to claim and download certificates.</span>";
    }
  }

  /* ---------- draw lines + eligibility ---------- */
  function render() {
    var d = ld(KEY), C = ld(CK), cards = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#xhConceptGrid .xh-category-card")), sum = 0, full = 0;
    SLUGS.forEach(function (s) { var p = pct(d[s]); sum += p; if (p >= 100) full++; });
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var a = c.querySelector(".xh-card-action"); if (!a) return;
      var s = slugOf(a.getAttribute("href")), e = d[s], p = pct(e), known = SLUGS.indexOf(s) > -1;
      var el = c.querySelector(".xhp-card");
      if (!el) { el = document.createElement("div"); el.className = "xhp-card"; a.parentNode.insertBefore(el, a); }
      var label = p >= 100 ? (C[s] ? "Certified ✓" : (USER ? "Eligible for certificate" : "Eligible — log in to Odoo to claim")) : (e && e.n ? done(e) + " / " + e.n + " read" : "Not started");
      var btn = C[s] ? "Download Certificate" : (USER ? "Claim Certificate" : "Log in to Odoo to claim");
      el.innerHTML = bar(label, p + "%", p) + (known && p >= 100 ? '<button type="button" class="xhp-btn" data-xhp="' + esc(s) + '">' + btn + "</button>" : "");
      if (known && p >= 100 && !C[s]) autoSync(s);
    });
    var o = Math.round(sum / SLUGS.length), all = full === SLUGS.length, h = document.getElementById("xhpOverall");
    if (!h) {
      var m = document.querySelector("#xhConceptsPage .xh-hero-content"); if (!m) return;
      h = document.createElement("div"); h.id = "xhpOverall"; h.className = "xhp-overall"; m.appendChild(h);
    }
    h.innerHTML = bar("Your learning progress · " + full + " of " + SLUGS.length + " categories complete", o + "%", o) +
      (all ? '<button type="button" class="xhp-btn xhp-main" data-xhp="main">' + (C.main ? "Download Main Certificate" : (USER ? "Main certificate unlocked — Claim it" : "Main certificate unlocked — log in to Odoo to claim")) + "</button>" : "");
    if (all && !C.main) autoSync("main");
    panel();
  }

  /* ---------- completion sync: only for GENUINE completions, only when signed in, once per slug ---------- */
  function ensureComplete(slug) {
    if (SYNCED[slug]) return Promise.resolve();
    if (INFLIGHT[slug]) return INFLIGHT[slug];          /* share one request between auto-sync and a manual claim */
    INFLIGHT[slug] = (async function () {
      var body = { slug: slug }, i;
      if (slug === "main") {
        for (i = 0; i < SLUGS.length; i++) await ensureComplete(SLUGS[i]);
      } else {
        var e = ld(KEY)[slug];
        body.readIds = ((e && e.r) || []).slice(0, 300);
      }
      await api("POST", "/v1/complete", body);
      SYNCED[slug] = true;
    })().then(function () { delete INFLIGHT[slug]; }, function (err) { delete INFLIGHT[slug]; throw err; });
    return INFLIGHT[slug];
  }
  function autoSync(slug) {
    if (!configured() || !USER || !ME_LOADED || SYNCED[slug] || INFLIGHT[slug] || FAILED[slug]) return;
    ensureComplete(slug).catch(function (e) {
      FAILED[slug] = true;                               /* don't retry a refused sync on every re-render */
      console.warn("XH cert sync (" + slug + "):", e && e.message);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- claim / download certificate ---------- */
  async function act(slug) {
    var C = ld(CK), have = !!C[slug];
    if (!configured()) { alert("The certificate service is not connected yet. Please try again later."); return; }
    if (!USER) { signIn(); return; }

    var d = ld(KEY), isMain = slug === "main";
    if (have) {
      /* already issued: re-read the authoritative record from the server (idempotent) so the JPG can never be drawn from edited local data */
    } else if (isMain) {
      if (!SLUGS.every(function (s) { return pct(d[s]) >= 100; })) {
        alert("You must complete all 17 categories to unlock the Main Space Science Mastery certificate.");
        return;
      }
    } else {
      var e = d[slug];
      if (SLUGS.indexOf(slug) < 0) { alert("This category is not part of the certificate programme."); return; }
      if (!e || pct(e) < 100) {
        alert("You must complete all articles and quizzes in this category to be eligible for certification.");
        return;
      }
    }
    if (BUSY["act:" + slug]) return;
    BUSY["act:" + slug] = true;
    try {
      if (!have) await ensureComplete(slug);
      var r = await api("POST", "/v1/certificate", { slug: slug });
      var rec = toRec(r.certificate);
      C = ld(CK); C[slug] = rec; st(CK, C);
      render();
      draw(rec);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("XH cert issuance failed:", err);
      alert(errMsg(err));
    } finally {
      BUSY["act:" + slug] = false;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- certificate canvas image generator (client-side, no paid storage) ---------- */
  function lib(src) {
    return new Promise(function (ok) {
      if (window.qrcode) return ok();
      var s = document.createElement("script"); s.src = src; s.onload = ok; s.onerror = ok; document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  async function draw(c) {
    // TEMPLATE: clean copy of the supplied "Under the Stars" certificate artwork.
    // All permanent art (logo, title, Earth, galaxy, silver arcs, duration/level capsule, 4 feature icons,
    // founder signature, tagline) is the original picture. Only the variable fields are removed from it and
    // drawn live below: Certificate ID, learner name, course/category title, completion date, QR code.
    // Output is a JPG download. No Firestore / identity / eligibility logic lives in this function.
    if (!document.getElementById("xhcFonts")) {
      var l = document.createElement("link"); l.rel = "stylesheet"; l.id = "xhcFonts";
      l.href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,700;1,500&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500&display=swap";
      document.head.appendChild(l);
    }
    await lib("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.min.js");
    try {
      await document.fonts.load('500 90px "Playfair Display"');
      await document.fonts.load('italic 38px "Playfair Display"');
      await document.fonts.load('400 20px "Poppins"');
    } catch (e) {}

    var W = 1402, H = 1122, cv = document.createElement("canvas");
    cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
    var x = cv.getContext("2d");
    x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; x.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
    var artwork = new Image();
    artwork.src = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
    try { await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) { artwork.onload = resolve; artwork.onerror = reject; }); }
    catch (e) { alert("The X HORIZON certificate template could not be loaded. Please refresh and try again."); return; }
    x.fillStyle = "#02050d"; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);   /* opaque base (JPG has no transparency) */
    x.drawImage(artwork, 0, 0, W, H);

    function fitText(text, maxWidth, initialSize, minSize, family, weight) {
      var size = initialSize;
      while (size > minSize) {
        x.font = (weight ? weight + " " : "") + size + "px " + family;
        if (x.measureText(text).width <= maxWidth) break;
        size -= 2;
      }
      return size;
    }

    // Certificate ID — top-left field, under the "CERTIFICATE ID" label (light blue, as in the template).
    var idText = String(c.id || "");
    x.textAlign = "left"; x.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    var idSize = fitText(idText, 168, 19, 12, 'Poppins, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif', "400");
    x.font = "400 " + idSize + "px Poppins, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
    x.fillStyle = "#74bdf6"; x.fillText(idText, 54, 121, 168);

    // Learner name — clean serif in the template's silver-metal tone that blends to soft blue at the base,
    // centred on the blue underline.
    var name = String(c.learnerName || c.name || "Learner");
    x.textAlign = "center"; x.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    var NAMEFONT = '"Playfair Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
    var nameSize = fitText(name, 640, 90, 30, NAMEFONT, "500");
    x.font = "500 " + nameSize + "px " + NAMEFONT;
    var ng = x.createLinearGradient(0, 385, 0, 462);
    ng.addColorStop(0, "#f4f5f8"); ng.addColorStop(0.45, "#dcdee3"); ng.addColorStop(0.75, "#c4d6ee"); ng.addColorStop(1, "#8db6ee");
    x.shadowColor = "rgba(96,160,255,.30)"; x.shadowBlur = 5;
    x.fillStyle = ng; x.fillText(name, 701, 450, 640);
    x.shadowBlur = 0; x.shadowColor = "transparent";

    // Course / category title — blue italic serif gradient, centred under "for successfully completing the course".
    var course = String(c.cat || c.course || "Astronomy Learning");
    var SERIF = '"Playfair Display", Georgia, serif';
    var courseSize = fitText(course, 560, 40, 17, SERIF, "italic");
    x.font = "italic " + courseSize + "px " + SERIF;
    var cg = x.createLinearGradient(0, 536, 0, 582);
    cg.addColorStop(0, "#c3e2fa"); cg.addColorStop(0.55, "#8dbff0"); cg.addColorStop(1, "#69a6e6");
    x.fillStyle = cg; x.textAlign = "center"; x.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    x.fillText(course, 701, 572, 560);

    // Completion date — inside the capsule, left-aligned under "COMPLETED ON" (same as the template).
    var dateText = String(c.date || fmtDate(new Date().toISOString()));
    x.textAlign = "left"; x.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    var dSize = fitText(dateText, 118, 17, 11, 'Poppins, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif', "300");
    x.font = "300 " + dSize + "px Poppins, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
    x.fillStyle = "#ebe6e2"; x.fillText(dateText, 913, 713, 118);

    // Verification QR — drawn inside the template's white QR panel (x 1178–1304, y 916–1042).
    try {
      if (typeof qrcode === "function") {
        var q = qrcode(0, "M");
        q.addData(location.origin + location.pathname + "?verify=" + encodeURIComponent(c.id) + (c.verificationCode ? "&code=" + encodeURIComponent(c.verificationCode) : "") + "#xhCertPanel");
        q.make();
        var modules = q.getModuleCount(), qrSize = 112, qrX = 1185, qrY = 923, cell = qrSize / modules;
        x.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; x.fillRect(1178, 916, 127, 127);
        x.fillStyle = "#000000";
        for (var r = 0; r < modules; r++) for (var k = 0; k < modules; k++) {
          if (q.isDark(r, k)) x.fillRect(qrX + k * cell, qrY + r * cell, cell + 0.35, cell + 0.35);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { console.warn("Certificate QR generation failed:", e); }

    cv.toBlob(function (blob) {
      if (!blob) { alert("Certificate image could not be generated. Please try again."); return; }
      var fname = String(c.id || "XH-Certificate") + ".jpg";
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var ua = navigator.userAgent || "";
      var iOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) || (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
      /* browsers that ignore a script-started save and just open the image as a preview */
      var weak = iOS || /FBAN|FBAV|Instagram|Line\/|MicroMessenger|; wv\)|CriOS|FxiOS|EdgiOS/i.test(ua);
      var framed = false; try { framed = window.self !== window.top; } catch (e) { framed = true; }

      function saveLink(a) {
        a.href = url; a.download = fname; a.rel = "noopener";
        return a;
      }
      function direct() {
        var a = saveLink(document.createElement("a")); a.style.display = "none";
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
        setTimeout(function () { if (a.parentNode) a.parentNode.removeChild(a); }, 1500);
      }

      if (!weak && !framed) {            /* desktop / Android browsers: straight download */
        direct();
        setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 60000);
        return;
      }

      /* Weak browsers: a fresh tap on a real download link is the only reliable way to save, so offer it. */
      var old = document.getElementById("xhcDlBar"); if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
      var bar = document.createElement("div"); bar.id = "xhcDlBar";
      bar.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483647;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;max-width:92vw;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:#0b0b0b;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);font:500 14px/1.3 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#fff";
      var msg = document.createElement("span"); msg.textContent = "Your certificate is ready";
      var dl = saveLink(document.createElement("a")); dl.textContent = "Download JPG";
      dl.style.cssText = "padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#000;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700";
      dl.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        /* iPhone / iPad: use the share sheet ("Save Image" / "Save to Files") when available */
        try {
          var file = new File([blob], fname, { type: "image/jpeg" });
          if (iOS && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            navigator.share({ files: [file], title: "X HORIZON Certificate" }).catch(function () {});
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      });
      var x2 = document.createElement("button"); x2.type = "button"; x2.textContent = "×"; x2.setAttribute("aria-label", "Close");
      x2.style.cssText = "border:0;background:transparent;color:#bbb;font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px";
      x2.addEventListener("click", function () { if (bar.parentNode) bar.parentNode.removeChild(bar); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); });
      bar.appendChild(msg); bar.appendChild(dl); bar.appendChild(x2);
      document.body.appendChild(bar);
    }, "image/jpeg", 0.95);
  }

  /* ---------- certificate list ---------- */
  function panel() {
    var C = ld(CK), el = document.getElementById("xhcList");
    if (!el) return;
    var ks = Object.keys(C);
    el.innerHTML = ks.length ? ks.map(function (k) {
      var c = C[k];
      return '<div class="xhc-row"><span>' + esc(c.cat) + "<small>" + esc(c.id) + " · " + esc(c.date) + '</small></span><button type="button" class="xhp-btn" data-xhp="' + esc(k) + '">Download</button></div>';
    }).join("") : '<div class="xhc-empty">' + (USER ? "No certificates yet. Finish every article in a category to unlock one." : "Log in to Odoo to see and download your certificates.") + "</div>";
  }

  /* ---------- public certificate verification (read-only API, no login needed) ---------- */
  function parseVerifyInput(raw) {
    var id = "", code = "";
    String(raw || "").toUpperCase().split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(function (t) {
      if (t.indexOf("VCD-") === 0) code = t; else if (!id) id = t;
    });
    return { id: id, code: code };
  }
  async function verify(raw, codeFromUrl) {
    var out = document.getElementById("xhcVerifyOut");
    if (!out) return;
    var p = parseVerifyInput(raw);
    if (codeFromUrl && !p.code) p.code = String(codeFromUrl).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!p.id) return;
    if (!configured()) { out.textContent = "Verification service is not connected yet."; return; }
    out.textContent = "Checking certificate verification...";
    try {
      var sdk = await fb();
      if (!sdk || !FBS) throw new Error("firebase_unavailable");
      var fs = FBS.fs, snap = await fs.getDoc(fs.doc(FBS.db, "certificates", p.id));
      if (!snap.exists()) { out.textContent = "No certificate found with ID: " + p.id + ". Please verify the certificate number."; return; }
      var d = snap.data(), valid = d.status === "active", codeMatched = !!p.code && p.code === String(d.verificationCode || "").toUpperCase();
      if (!valid) {
        out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ff8a8a;font-weight:bold;">✕ This certificate is not valid (' + esc(String(d.status || "inactive").toUpperCase()) + ")</span> — ID: " + esc(p.id);
        return;
      }
      var shownName = codeMatched ? (d.learnerName || d.name || "Learner") : "Certificate holder";
      out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#7fb0ff;font-weight:bold;">✓ Valid Certificate (ACTIVE)</span> — ' +
        esc(shownName) + ' completed "<strong>' + esc(d.cat || "Learning pathway") + '</strong>" (' +
        (d.completedArticleCount || d.count || 0) + " articles) on " + esc(fmtDate(d.issuedAt)) + ". " +
        '<small style="display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#a8a8a8;">Certificate ID: ' + esc(p.id) +
        (codeMatched ? " · Verification code matched ✓" : " · Add the verification code after the ID (or scan the certificate QR code) to confirm the holder's name") + "</small>";
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("XH verify lookup failed:", e);
      out.textContent = "Could not verify certificate right now. Please try again.";
    }
  }

  /* ---------- tracker mode: runs on individual category pages ---------- */
  function track(slug) {
    var sel = window.XH_ARTICLE_SELECTOR || "[data-xh-article],.xh-article-card,.xh-category-card,article";
    var cards = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(sel)).filter(function (c) { return c.querySelector("h2,h3,h4"); });
    if (!cards.length) return;
    var totalCount = TOPIC_COUNTS[slug] || cards.length;
    window.XHProgress.read(slug, null, totalCount);

    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var id = c.querySelector("h2,h3,h4").textContent.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 80), t = null, io = null;
      if (window.XHProgress.get(slug).r.indexOf(id) > -1) return;
      function mark() {
        window.XHProgress.read(slug, id, totalCount);
        if (io) io.disconnect();
        if (t) clearTimeout(t);
      }
      c.addEventListener("click", mark);
      io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
        es.forEach(function (x) {
          if (x.isIntersecting && !t) t = setTimeout(mark, DWELL);
          else if (!x.isIntersecting && t) { clearTimeout(t); t = null; }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.6 });
      io.observe(c);
    });
  }

  /* Console helper: XHCertDiag() compares this browser's stored page counts with the table the server enforces. */
  window.XHCertDiag = function () {
    var d = ld(KEY), rows = SLUGS.map(function (s) {
      var e = d[s] || { r: [], n: 0 };
      return { slug: s, pageReportsTotal: e.n || null, serverExpects: TOPIC_COUNTS[s], read: done(e), match: !e.n ? "page not visited yet" : (e.n === TOPIC_COUNTS[s] ? "ok" : "MISMATCH") };
    });
    if (window.console && console.table) console.table(rows);
    return rows;
  };

  function init() {
    if (window.__xhCertInit) return;           /* Odoo can re-run inline scripts in edit mode; never bind twice */
    var grid = document.getElementById("xhConceptGrid");
    if (!grid) {
      var s = slugOf(location.pathname);
      if (SLUGS.indexOf(s) > -1) track(s);
      return;
    }
    window.__xhCertInit = true;
    render();
    renderAuth();
    if (configured()) fb().then(function () { onUser(); });
    new MutationObserver(function () { setTimeout(render, 60); }).observe(grid, { childList: true });
    document.addEventListener("xhprogress", render);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () { if (!document.hidden) onUser(); });
    window.addEventListener("storage", function (e) { if (e.key === KEY || e.key === CK) render(); });
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".xhp-btn");
      if (b) { act(b.getAttribute("data-xhp")); return; }
      var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-xhc-auth]");
      if (a) { if (a.getAttribute("data-xhc-auth") === "in") signIn(); else signOut(); }
    });
    var vb = document.getElementById("xhcVerifyBtn"), vi = document.getElementById("xhcVerifyId");
    if (vb && vi) {
      vb.addEventListener("click", function () { verify(vi.value); });
      vi.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") verify(vi.value); });
    }
    var qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search), q = qs.get("verify");
    if (q && vi) {
      vi.value = q;
      verify(q, qs.get("code"));
      var p = document.getElementById("xhCertPanel");
      if (p) p.scrollIntoView();
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "complete") setTimeout(init, 200);
  else window.addEventListener("load", function () { setTimeout(init, 200); });
})();
</script>
